articles.title: FC Kohli: The IT visionary India forgot to remember
articles.summary: Born in Peshawar in 1924, Kohli was a gold medallist from Lahore's Government College. After his father's death during his final year, he applied to join the Indian Navy and was successfully selected. This marks the beginning of his service journey, hinting at a significant career ahead in the defence forces.

articles.title: West Asia conflict: Explosions heard in Doha after key areas evacuated
articles.summary: Early Saturday, blasts were reported in Doha, Qatar, prompting evacuations by the interior ministry. Interceptors were observed over the capital, indicating a likely air defense response to a significant security incident. This event underscores the volatile nature of regional security and the critical role of air defense capabilities, offering a relevant case study for SSB aspirants on international defence dynamics.

articles.title: Analysts say US threat of ‘no quarter’ for Iran violates international law
articles.summary: Rights groups have condemned US Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth's "no quarter" statement regarding Iran. This outrage emerges amidst ongoing US and Israeli military campaigns against Iran. The controversial remark highlights escalating tensions and the severe nature of the conflict, sparking international concern over potential human rights implications during sustained military operations.

articles.title: European round-up: Marseille boost Champions League hopes as Villarreal falter
articles.summary: Marseille secured a crucial 1-0 victory against Auxerre in a French Ligue 1 football match. A second-half goal from Amine Gouiri propelled Marseille, significantly boosting their hopes for Champions League qualification. This result underscores the intense competition within top European leagues and the strategic importance of every match in achieving season-long objectives.

articles.title: LS3-Powered 1960 Chevrolet El Camino 6-Speed by The Roadster Shop
articles.summary: This article details the custom build of a 1960 Chevrolet El Camino by Roadster Shop, featuring advanced automotive engineering. It integrates a high-performance Fast Track chassis, a robust 6.2-liter LS3 V8 engine, and a six-speed manual transmission. This project exemplifies skilled craftsmanship and technological application in vehicle modification, showcasing how classic designs are enhanced with modern powertrain and chassis innovations for superior performance and control.

articles.title: Mines Across Hormuz Would Create Lethal Barrier
articles.summary: Mining the Strait of Hormuz would critically obstruct this vital global sea corridor, making it impassable for tankers and naval escorts from all nations, including Iran. This act severely threatens international maritime trade and energy security. For SSB aspirants, understanding such geopolitical choke points emphasizes the critical role of maritime security and naval defence in safeguarding global commerce and stability.

articles.title: Iran plane leaves India with sailors, bodies as Indian ships win Hormuz reprieve
articles.summary: An Iranian-chartered plane departed southern India on Friday, repatriating sailors from an Iranian naval vessel that had docked. The flight also carried the bodies of crew members killed in an undisclosed incident, highlighting international maritime cooperation. This operation underscores diplomatic efforts in managing naval personnel movements and tragic casualties across borders.

articles.title: Middle East war death toll hits 2,000 — Report
articles.summary: Following US and Israeli strikes on Iran on February 28, conflict has significantly escalated and spread across the Middle East region. Reports indicate a concerning rise in casualties across various countries in the area. This situation marks a substantial broadening of military engagements and tensions, profoundly impacting the geopolitical stability of the wider Middle East.
